quotes.text_en: Technology is nothing. What's important is that you have a faith in people, that they're basically good and smart, and if you give them tools, they'll do wonderful things with them.
quotes.text_zh: 技术本身什么都不是。重要的是你对人有信心，相信他们本质上是善良和聪明的，如果你给他们工具，他们会用这些工具做出美妙的事情。
quotes.thinking_pattern: 人文主义思维——技术为人服务
quotes.usage_scenario: 讨论技术哲学、技术与人文关系时引用

quotes.text_en: The computer is the most remarkable tool that we've ever come up with. It's the equivalent of a bicycle for our minds.
quotes.text_zh: 计算机是我们发明过的最了不起的工具。它是我们思维的自行车。
quotes.thinking_pattern: 类比思维——用自行车比喻计算机的放大效应
quotes.usage_scenario: 讨论计算机的意义、技术赋能人类时引用

quotes.text_en: I think humanity is at a crossroads. On the one hand, we have the potential to create amazing things. On the other hand, we have the potential to destroy ourselves.
quotes.text_zh: 我认为人类正处于一个十字路口。一方面，我们有创造惊人事物的潜力。另一方面，我们也有毁灭自己的潜力。
quotes.thinking_pattern: 辩证思维——技术的双面性
quotes.usage_scenario: 讨论技术伦理、人类未来时引用

quotes.text_en: What a computer is to me is it's the most remarkable tool that we've ever come up with, and it's the equivalent of a bicycle for our minds.
quotes.text_zh: 计算机对我来说，是我们发明过的最了不起的工具，它是我们思维的自行车。
quotes.thinking_pattern: 赋能思维——技术放大人的能力
quotes.usage_scenario: 讨论技术赋能、教育科技时引用

quotes.text_en: The reason Apple is able to create products like the iPad is because we've always tried to be at the intersection of technology and liberal arts.
quotes.text_zh: 苹果之所以能够创造出像iPad这样的产品，是因为我们一直努力站在技术与人文艺术的交汇处。
quotes.thinking_pattern: 交叉思维——科技与人文的融合
quotes.usage_scenario: 讨论产品创新、跨学科融合时引用

quotes.text_en: I believe that what we're doing is very important. I believe that we're at the beginning of a revolution in computing.
quotes.text_zh: 我相信我们正在做的事情非常重要。我相信我们正处于一场计算机革命的开端。
quotes.thinking_pattern: 远见思维——站在变革的起点
quotes.usage_scenario: 讨论行业趋势、技术变革时引用

quotes.text_en: The desktop computer industry is dead. There will be no more innovations in it.
quotes.text_zh: 台式电脑行业已经死了。它不会再有任何创新。
quotes.thinking_pattern: 颠覆思维——预见行业转折点
quotes.usage_scenario: 讨论行业趋势、技术变革时引用

quotes.text_en: Every once in a while, a revolutionary product comes along that changes everything. And if you're lucky, you get to work on just one of these in your career.
quotes.text_zh: 每隔一段时间，就会有一款革命性的产品出现，改变一切。如果你幸运的话，在你的职业生涯中能参与其中一款。
quotes.thinking_pattern: 革命性思维——追求改变一切的产品
quotes.usage_scenario: 讨论产品愿景、创新意义时引用

quotes.text_en: You can't converge everything into one device. People want different things for different purposes.
quotes.text_zh: 你不能把所有东西都融合到一个设备中。人们在不同场景下需要不同的东西。
quotes.thinking_pattern: 场景化思维——不同场景需要不同产品
quotes.usage_scenario: 讨论产品线规划、设备定位时引用

quotes.text_en: I want to create a tool that amplifies human intellect. That's the biggest value I can add.
quotes.text_zh: 我想创造一个放大人类智慧的工具。这是我能增加的最大价值。
quotes.thinking_pattern: 赋能思维——技术是人的延伸
quotes.usage_scenario: 讨论技术愿景、产品价值时引用
